item.title: Data Flow From API to UI: The Parts That Actually Break
item.description:
Drawing the layers for API-to-UI data flow is the part everyone can do: networking fetches, a view model holds state, the view renders. Boxes and arrows, done in an interview in two minutes. That diagram is also where the real problems are not. The hard parts of data flow are the ones the diagram hides, and they are where shipping apps actually break.

Here is a snippet close to what a lot of view models really contain. It looks reasonable. It has a bug that ships to production constantly.
